description: The Markdown line that puts GitShine's animated stats card (contribution graph, streaks, stars, top languages) on a GitHub profile README, with step-by-step instructions for adding it. Free, no token.

layout.description: full (default): graph, totals, streaks and languages. Half width (pair two side by side): compact (streak), languages, week (contributions by weekday), repos (most-starred repositories). Full width: years (a bar per year), sky (the year as a night sky), wrapped (this year so far).

theme.description: auto (default) follows the viewer's light or dark mode; transparent has no background; dimmed, tokyonight, dracula and catppuccin are editor palettes.

username.description: A GitHub username, @handle or profile URL (organizations aren't supported).

name: get_readme_card
title: README stats card
